verdict.rationale: Crossmint's documented agent stack (Agent Cards, Agent Wallets, Agent Checkouts) sits entirely on the buyer/agent side. It pays x402/MPP endpoints and completes checkouts at any merchant URL without merchant involvement. The pack shows no merchant-facing self-serve path for accepting agent traffic, such as a setting to enable, an agreement to sign, or a guide to publishing a paid endpoint. Its general headless checkout lets apps accept card and crypto payments, but nothing in the docs ties it to agent traffic.
